    var cookies ={
        create: function(name, value, days2expire, path){
            var date = new Date();
            date.setTime(date.getTime() + (days2expire * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
            var expires = date.toUTCString();
            document.cookie = name + '=' + value + ';' + 'expires=' + expires + ';' + 'path=' + path + ';';
        },
        read: function(name){
            var cookie_value = "",
                current_cookie = "",
                name_expr = name + "=",
                all_cookies = document.cookie.split(';'),
                n = all_cookies.length;

            for(var i = 0; i < n; i++){
                current_cookie = all_cookies[i].trim();
                if(current_cookie.indexOf(name_expr) === 0){
                    cookie_value = current_cookie.substring(name_expr.length, current_cookie.length);
                    break;
                }
            }
            return cookie_value;
        },
        update: function(name, val){
            this.create(name, val, 300, "/");
        },
        remove: function(name){
            document.cookie = name + "=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; path=/";
        }
    };

            var date = new Date();
            date.setTime(date.getTime() + (days2expire * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
            var expires = date.toUTCString();
            document.cookie = name + '=' + value + ';' + 'expires=' + expires + ';' + 'path=' + path + ';';
        },
        read: function(name){
            var cookie_value = "",
                current_cookie = "",
                name_expr = name + "=",
                all_cookies = document.cookie.split(';'),
                n = all_cookies.length;

            for(var i = 0; i < n; i++){

                if(current_cookie.indexOf(name_expr) === 0){
                    cookie_value = current_cookie.substring(name_expr.length, current_cookie.length);
                    break;
                }
            }
            return cookie_value;

        update: function(name, val){
            this.create(name, val, 300, "/");
        },
        remove: function(name){
            document.cookie = name + "=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; path=/";
        }
    };

    <script>
        var bc_sha256  = '';

        //setup BC code
        window.BCLighthouseTag = window.BCLighthouseTag || { cmd: [] };
        window.BCLighthouseTag.session = window.BCLighthouseTag.session || {};
        window.BCLighthouseTag.metadata = {
            acct_type: "guest"
        }

        // Capture utm params into a browser-session cookie (latest touch wins, whole set replaced)
        var utm_get = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        if(utm_get.get("utm_source") || utm_get.get("utm_medium") || utm_get.get("utm_campaign")){
            document.cookie = "utm_session=" + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify({
                utm_source:   utm_get.get("utm_source")   || "",
                utm_medium:   utm_get.get("utm_medium")   || "",
                utm_campaign: utm_get.get("utm_campaign") || ""
            })) + "; path=/";
        }

        // Replay stored utm params on every pageview this session; skip empty values
        if(getCookie("utm_session")){
            var utm_info = JSON.parse(getCookie("utm_session"));
            if(utm_info.utm_source)   BCLighthouseTag.session.utm_source   = utm_info.utm_source;
            if(utm_info.utm_medium)   BCLighthouseTag.session.utm_medium   = utm_info.utm_medium;
            if(utm_info.utm_campaign) BCLighthouseTag.session.utm_campaign = utm_info.utm_campaign;
        }

        //send newsletter info
        if(getCookie("newsletter_info")) {
            var n_info = JSON.parse(getCookie("newsletter_info"));
            bc_sha256 = n_info.sha256;
            bc_md5    = n_info.md5;

            // Newsletter signup attribution rides the External ID alone —
            // the External-profile dimensions (dict off external_id) replaced
            // the retired bc_* key-values (last two removed 2026-09).
            if(n_info.sub_id) BCLighthouseTag.session.external_id = n_info.sub_id;
        }
        
        //include hash
        if(bc_sha256) {
            BCLighthouseTag.cmd.push(function() {
                // Set Hashed Email
                BCLighthouseTag.setHashedEmail('logged_in', { 'SHA256': bc_sha256, 'MD5': bc_md5 });
            });
        }

        //pageviews that see sponsorship
        if(getCookie('sponsor_newsletter_user')){
            gtag('event', 'sponsor_sponsorship', {'event_label': bc_utype});
        }

    // Detect if browser is Safari on iOS
    function is_ios_safari(){
        var ua = navigator.userAgent;
        return /iP(hone|ad|od)/.test(ua) && /Safari/.test(ua) && !/CriOS|FxiOS|OPiOS|EdgiOS/.test(ua);
    }

    // Detect OS
    function get_mobile_type(){
        var userAgent = navigator.userAgent || navigator.vendor || window.opera;

        if(/iPhone|iPad|iPod/i.test(userAgent)){
            return "iOS";
        } else if(/Android/i.test(userAgent)){
            return "Android";
        } else {
            return "Other";
        }
    }

    // Build OneLink URL with deep_link_value for current page
    var pagePath = window.location.pathname.replace(/^\//, '');
    var oneLinkUrl = "https://snopes.onelink.me/lstM?deep_link_value=" + encodeURIComponent(pagePath);

        // Safari iOS — rely on native Smart App Banner, hide custom one
        document.body.classList.remove("app-promo");

(function() {
    var banner = document.getElementById('newsletter-login-banner');
    var closeBtn = document.getElementById('newsletter-login-close');

    // Check if user is logged in, from newsletter, and is a paid user (via cookies)
    var isLoggedIn = getCookie('login_data');
    var fromNewsletter = getCookie('from_newsletter');
    var isPaidUser = getCookie('newsletter_paid_user');

    // Only show if NOT logged in AND from newsletter AND is paid user
    if(isLoggedIn || !fromNewsletter || !isPaidUser) {
        return;
    }

    // Clear old dismissals (after 7 days)
    var dismissedTime = localStorage.getItem('newsletter_login_banner_dismissed');
    if(dismissedTime) {
        var sevenDays = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
        if(Date.now() - parseInt(dismissedTime) > sevenDays) {
            localStorage.removeItem('newsletter_login_banner_dismissed');
        }
    }

    // Check if banner was dismissed
    if(localStorage.getItem('newsletter_login_banner_dismissed')) {
        return;
    }

    // Show the banner
    banner.style.display = 'block';

    // Handle close button click
    closeBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        banner.style.display = 'none';
        // Remember dismissal for 7 days
        localStorage.setItem('newsletter_login_banner_dismissed', Date.now());
    });
})();
</script>

    var cookies ={
        create: function(name, value, days2expire, path){
            var date = new Date();
            date.setTime(date.getTime() + (days2expire * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
            var expires = date.toUTCString();
            document.cookie = name + '=' + value + ';' + 'expires=' + expires + ';' + 'path=' + path + ';';
        },
        read: function(name){
            var cookie_value = "",
                current_cookie = "",
                name_expr = name + "=",
                all_cookies = document.cookie.split(';'),
                n = all_cookies.length;

            for(var i = 0; i < n; i++){
                current_cookie = all_cookies[i].trim();
                if(current_cookie.indexOf(name_expr) === 0){
                    cookie_value = current_cookie.substring(name_expr.length, current_cookie.length);
                    break;
                }
            }
            return cookie_value;
        },
        update: function(name, val){
            this.create(name, val, 300, "/");
        },
        remove: function(name){
            document.cookie = name + "=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; path=/";
        }
    };
    </script>

    <script>
        var bc_sha256  = '';
        var bc_md5     = '';
        var bc_utype   = 'guest';

        //setup BC code
        window.BCLighthouseTag = window.BCLighthouseTag || { cmd: [] };
        window.BCLighthouseTag.session = window.BCLighthouseTag.session || {};
        window.BCLighthouseTag.metadata = {
            acct_type: "guest"
        }

        // Capture utm params into a browser-session cookie (latest touch wins, whole set replaced)
        var utm_get = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        if(utm_get.get("utm_source") || utm_get.get("utm_medium") || utm_get.get("utm_campaign")){
            document.cookie = "utm_session=" + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify({
                utm_source:   utm_get.get("utm_source")   || "",
                utm_medium:   utm_get.get("utm_medium")   || "",
                utm_campaign: utm_get.get("utm_campaign") || ""
            })) + "; path=/";
        }

        // Replay stored utm params on every pageview this session; skip empty values
        if(getCookie("utm_session")){
            var utm_info = JSON.parse(getCookie("utm_session"));
            if(utm_info.utm_source)   BCLighthouseTag.session.utm_source   = utm_info.utm_source;
            if(utm_info.utm_medium)   BCLighthouseTag.session.utm_medium   = utm_info.utm_medium;
            if(utm_info.utm_campaign) BCLighthouseTag.session.utm_campaign = utm_info.utm_campaign;
        }

        //send newsletter info
        if(getCookie("newsletter_info")) {
            var n_info = JSON.parse(getCookie("newsletter_info"));
            bc_sha256 = n_info.sha256;
            bc_md5    = n_info.md5;

            // Newsletter signup attribution rides the External ID alone —
            // the External-profile dimensions (dict off external_id) replaced
            // the retired bc_* key-values (last two removed 2026-09).
            if(n_info.sub_id) BCLighthouseTag.session.external_id = n_info.sub_id;
        }
        
        //include hash
        if(bc_sha256) {
            BCLighthouseTag.cmd.push(function() {
                // Set Hashed Email
                BCLighthouseTag.setHashedEmail('logged_in', { 'SHA256': bc_sha256, 'MD5': bc_md5 });
            });
        }

        //pageviews that see sponsorship
        if(getCookie('sponsor_newsletter_user')){
            gtag('event', 'sponsor_sponsorship', {'event_label': bc_utype});
        }

    // Clear old dismissals (after 7 days)
    var dismissedTime = localStorage.getItem('newsletter_login_banner_dismissed');

        var sevenDays = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
        if(Date.now() - parseInt(dismissedTime) > sevenDays) {
            localStorage.removeItem('newsletter_login_banner_dismissed');
        }
    }

    // Check if banner was dismissed
    if(localStorage.getItem('newsletter_login_banner_dismissed')) {
        return;

    // Show the banner
    banner.style.display = 'block';

    // Handle close button click
    closeBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        banner.style.display = 'none';
        // Remember dismissal for 7 days
        localStorage.setItem('newsletter_login_banner_dismissed', Date.now());
    });
})();

<script>
    if('IntersectionObserver' in window && typeof(observer) === "undefined"){
    // We don't need to build the observer here anymore since we are building observers per item group
    var observers = [];
}
// If observer doesn't exist, add event listeners
else if(typeof(observer) === "undefined"){
    window.addEventListener('scroll', throttle(classic_lazy_load, 16));
    window.addEventListener('resize', throttle(classic_lazy_load, 16));
}

var global_items = [];
var device_type = get_device_type();

// Lazy Load images
lazy_load(".lazy-image", // Query
       "forever", // How long event listener should last ("forever" or "once")
       300, // Pixels
       0, // Time
       "on", // Status
       "" // Callback
       );

// Lazy Load iframes (ie: youtube, podcast, etc.)
lazy_load(".lazy_load_iframe", // Query
       "forever", // How long event listener should last ("forever" or "once")
       500, // Pixels
       0, // Time
       "on", // Status
       "" // Callback
       );

var req_id = 0;
// Initial call for lazy load
function lazy_load(query, style, in_advance, backup_time, status, callback){
    console.log("Lazy Loading items in query: "+query);
    req_id++;

    // If you just don't want to lazy load it, and you want it to load right away
    if(status == "off" || (status != "on" && device_type != status)){
        if(status == "off") var reason = "status is set to off";
        else var reason = "device type is: "+device_type+" and your status is set to: "+status;

        console.log("not lazy loading because "+reason);
        callback();
        return;
    }

    var intersection_observer = false;
    if('IntersectionObserver' in window){
        intersection_observer = true;

        var interactSettings = {
            rootMargin: in_advance+'px 0px '+in_advance+'px 0px'
        };

        var observer = new IntersectionObserver(on_intersection, interactSettings);
        observers.push(observer);
    }

    // Get all items from query
    var items = document.querySelectorAll(query);
    // Add callback to each item
    for(var i = 0; i < items.length; i++){
        var item = items[i];
        if(callback != ""){
            var mycallback     = 'lazy_load_'+guid()+"_"+req_id;
            window[mycallback] = callback;
            item.dataset.callback = mycallback;
        }

        // Setting timers to execute on item if not loaded in a certain amount of time (if specified)
        if(backup_time > 0) setTimeout(function(){ window[item.dataset.callback](); }, backup_time);
        if(intersection_observer) observer.observe(item);
    }
    // Lazy loaded classic style
    if(!intersection_observer){
        global_items.push({"style": style, "items": items, "in_advance": in_advance, "used": 0});
        classic_lazy_load();
    }
}
// On item intersection for IntersectionObserver
function on_intersection(items, this_observer){
    items.forEach(function(item){
        if(item.isIntersecting){
            this_observer.unobserve(item.target);

            // Images
            if(item.target.tagName == "IMG" || item.target.tagName == "IFRAME"){
                if(item.target.dataset.src) item.target.src = item.target.dataset.src;
                if(item.target.dataset.srcset) item.target.srcset = item.target.dataset.srcset;
                item.target.onload = function(item){ item.target.classList.add('loaded') }
            }
            // Images in disguise as divs
            else if(item.target.classList.contains("video-background-image")){
                item.target.style.backgroundImage = "url('"+item.target.dataset.src+"')";
                item.target.classList.add('loaded');
            }
            // Load from the id
            else window[item.target.dataset.callback]();
        }
    });
}
// Classic lazy load if IntersectionObserver doesn't exist
function classic_lazy_load(){
    for(var i = 0; i < global_items.length; i++){
        var item_array = global_items[i];

        if(item_array.style == "once" && item_array.used > 0) continue;

        for(var x = 0; x < item_array.items.length; x++){
            var item = item_array.items[x];

            if(item.offsetTop < window.innerHeight + window.pageYOffset + item_array.in_advance){
                // Images
                if(item.tagName == "IMG"){
                    if(item.target.dataset.src) item.target.src = item.target.dataset.src;
                    if(item.target.dataset.srcset) item.target.srcset = item.target.dataset.srcset;
                    item.onload = function(e){ item.classList.add('loaded'); }
                }
                // Load from the id
                else window[item.dataset.callback]();

                item_array.used++;
            }
        }
    }
}
// Called on scroll or resize for when IntersectionObserver doesn't exist
function throttle(func, wait, options){
    var context, args, result;
    var timeout = null;
    var previous = 0;
    if(!options) options = {};

    var later = function(){
        previous = options.leading === false ? 0 : Date.now();
        timeout = null;
        result = func.apply(context, args);

        if(!timeout) context = args = null;
    };

    return function(){
        var now = Date.now();

        if(!previous && options.leading === false) previous = now;

        var remaining = wait - (now - previous);
        context = this;
        args = arguments;

        if(remaining <= 0 || remaining > wait){
            if(timeout){
                clearTimeout(timeout);
                timeout = null;
            }

            previous = now;
            result = func.apply(context, args);

            if(!timeout) context = args = null;
        }
        else if(!timeout && options.trailing !== false){
            timeout = setTimeout(later, remaining);
        }

        return result;
    };
}
// Get random string
function guid(){
    function s4(){
        return Math.floor((1 + Math.random()) * 0x10000)
          .toString(16)
          .substring(1,5);
    }

    return s4() + s4() + '_' + s4() + s4();
}
// Get device type
function get_device_type(include_tablet){
    var ua = navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase();
    var device_type = "";

    // Tablet detection - returns "tablet" when include_tablet is true, otherwise "mobile"
    if(/(ipad|tablet|(android(?!.*mobile))|(windows(?!.*phone)(.*touch))|kindle|playbook|silk|(puffin(?!.*(IP|AP|WP))))/.test(ua)) device_type = include_tablet ? "tablet" : "mobile";
    // This is mobile
    else if(/(mobi|ipod|phone|blackberry|opera mini|fennec|minimo|symbian|psp|nintendo ds|archos|skyfire|puffin|blazer|bolt|gobrowser|iris|maemo|semc|teashark|uzard)/.test(ua)) device_type = "mobile";
    // Otherwise desktop
    else device_type = "desktop";

    return device_type;
}

    var cookies ={
        create: function(name, value, days2expire, path){
            var date = new Date();
            date.setTime(date.getTime() + (days2expire * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
            var expires = date.toUTCString();
            document.cookie = name + '=' + value + ';' + 'expires=' + expires + ';' + 'path=' + path + ';';
        },
        read: function(name){
            var cookie_value = "",
                current_cookie = "",
                name_expr = name + "=",
                all_cookies = document.cookie.split(';'),
                n = all_cookies.length;

            for(var i = 0; i < n; i++){
                current_cookie = all_cookies[i].trim();
                if(current_cookie.indexOf(name_expr) === 0){
                    cookie_value = current_cookie.substring(name_expr.length, current_cookie.length);
                    break;
                }
            }
            return cookie_value;
        },
        update: function(name, val){
            this.create(name, val, 300, "/");
        },
        remove: function(name){
            document.cookie = name + "=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; path=/";
        }
    };
